basic_info.description: You'll LOVE this stunning flex 2-3BR/1BA condo in the heart of the Lower Haight. This fun & gorgeous flat showcases extraordinary period details: soaring 11-foot ceilings, Victorian wainscoting, crown molding, picture railing & elegant pocket doors. Two decorative fireplaces & beautiful hardwood floors complete the authentic charm.  Flexible layout offers endless possibilities! In the photos, we've staged the front living room as *both* a formal living room and a 3rd bedroom. If you choose that layout, the dining room doubles as a casual living room - your choice - we've staged as both!  Enjoy morning coffee on your private deck steps from the eat-in kitchen. Convenient in-unit laundry, too! Unbeatable Walk Score of 98 & Transit Score 95, a bikers paradise, too! Step onto Haight Street for neighborhood favorites like Uvo Enoteca, Bar Jabroni, STOA, & Jules Pizza's artisanal pies. Steps to Duboce Park, Hayes Valley boutiques, the hot Divisadero Corridor & Page Slow Street. Excellent Muni, BART & tech shuttle access. Low HOA, Month-to-month parking available across the street, buyer to secure themselves. Don't Miss!
